protocol_overrides.scope: Iris SITL eight velocity configurations; original position P/attitude/rate PID; DIV1 only

height_task.coordinate: local NED, estimated height = frozen_ground_z - local_position.z; not Gazebo truth or terrain clearance
height_task.ground_freeze: Preserve immutable original xyz, heading, heading counter, ref_timestamp/ref_lat/ref_lon/ref_alt and all p/v reset counters. Height remains ground_z minus local z; global altitude target uses the same pre-arm ref_alt.
height_task.target_source: original navigator -> flight_mode_manager -> trajectory_setpoint; no external trajectory/attitude/rate publisher
height_task.takeoff: unchanged commander takeoff; wait for armed airborne POSCTL after original navigation completion; do not issue current-position Hold

reposition.command: MAV_CMD_DO_REPOSITION in one COMMAND_INT, frame5, target1/1
reposition.param4: One original navigator DO_REPOSITION with param4=task_yaw radians for this pinned receiver; no external attitude/rate/trajectory publisher. Do not add delta_heading again to this fresh post-alignment value.
reposition.xy: Once-captured fresh onboard trajectory XY, projected with immutable original NED reference; never measured-position or truth substitution
reposition.require: Fresh accepted addressed ACK, AUTO_LOITER and exact encoded target within 5s; pending only before qualification; no resend; raw/CLI representations checked separately

coordinate_reference_change.before_arm: Preserve immutable original xyz, heading, heading counter, ref_timestamp/ref_lat/ref_lon/ref_alt and all p/v reset counters. Height remains ground_z minus local z; global altitude target uses the same pre-arm ref_alt.
coordinate_reference_change.heading_exception_phase: TAKEOFF_PREPARATION only: armed, airborne, no ground contact, actual AUTO_TAKEOFF or POSCTL, before any DO_REPOSITION/AUTO_LOITER/excitation/observation
coordinate_reference_change.heading_delta_limit_basis: New conservative engineering admission cap, one quarter of unchanged 20deg yaw envelope; not a theoretical bound or held-out estimate. Chosen after historical PID diagnostic knowledge; disclose this development use.
coordinate_reference_change.height_limit_basis: Broad preparation envelope, not an exact reproduction of private delayed terrain>1.5m test. dist_bottom_valid=false is not proof of a valid range observation.

evidence.mag_aligned_in_flight: same primary 0->1; yaw_align true; not mag_fault, mag_field_disturbed, emergency reset, EV/GPS yaw takeover or filter fault
evidence.metadata_max_age_scope: Periodic estimator_status only; do not apply 0.5s to all metadata topics.
evidence.events_freshness: estimator_event_flags is event-only, no periodic heartbeat. Require pre-arm last event/counter snapshot and uninterrupted subscription/decoded history, contiguous information/warning change counters for new messages, no forbidden events. An old last event is not a new reset nor automatically stale failure; a missing topic or unobservable event interval is not zero. Do not force extra EKF publications.
evidence.metadata_age_basis: Pinned sources: estimator_status requested at 200ms logger interval; selector/status_flags publish about 1Hz or on change; events publish only on events. Separate 0.5/1.2s engineering guards, not claimed common sample rates.
evidence.pending: On first candidate, inhibit height command/admission while awaiting asynchronous alignment evidence for <=0.5s. Missing/late/contradictory evidence fails; do not silently accept immediately.
evidence.record: Original counters/delta/time/primary/alignment flags, pending and confirmation timestamps, actual status/land and controller diagnostics; no zero replacement for missing fields. No Gazebo truth.

coordinate_reference_change.after_exception: Any second heading event, including counter jump or estimator switch, fails. No heading changes after task_yaw_freeze through landing/disarm. Do not exempt landing resets.

entry.require: Original entry plus verified protocol04 alignment and once-only task yaw
entry.hover_start_event: only after entry passes; preserve candidate entry samples; verify the final 3 seconds independently in actual ULog

height_task.excitation_clock: unchanged first valid airborne AUTO_LOITER gate starts existing 12s settle; ready by gate+10s, else abort before gate+12s. Derive gate from diagnostic timestamp_sample and excitation_time, not host receipt time. Never reset/restart excitation while armed.
height_task.landing: unchanged commander mode auto:land; require landed and automatic disarm

excitation.V: same XY; pz=.1*E*sin(wt); positive Z is Down
excitation.derivatives: v=dp/dt,a=d2p/dt2, analytic product rule; once-only additive FF
excitation.source: single Navigator/FlightTask target plus guarded per-frame adapter; original position P retained; fixed yaw

diagnostic_gate.nu_in_pid: NaN on unselected axes; selected independent; Z groups phase1/2 PID handover, phase3 steady
diagnostic_gate.strict_failures: Any required check fails: stop and preserve, no additional flight.

pair_gate.source: V00/V01 PID noise scale (X .010751,Y .008080,Z .005138m/s); V03 provides consumed-state baseline. Fixed before any ESTA data.
pair_gate.per_pair_rule: candidate_rmse <= 1.25*paired_PID_rmse + frozen absolute allowance; each commanded/noncommanded axis separately
pair_gate.order: H24 then V24; PID first per seed, run25 V PID budgeted safety gate
pair_gate.window: 64s and32s halves consumed velocity;90s position/yaw; componentwise
pair_gate.calculation: ESTA <= 1.25 * same-seed PID + fixed allowance; acceptance is development noninferiority, not scientific superiority.

metrics.primary: time-weighted consumed per-axis velocity RMSE [0,64), each32s half; XY=sqrt((RMSE_X^2+RMSE_Y^2)/2), does not replace componentwise gates
metrics.secondary: velocity mean/std/IAE,90s position/yaw, nu, constraints, true-update acceleration/thrust TV, common-band spectrum and host wall-time
metrics.missing: stop first failure; retain attempts and unexecuted missing, no imputation/retry; all48+42pairs required
metrics.interpretation: fixed-gain axis configuration development ablation; n3/task; not general superiority, not fully independent random sources

protocol_overrides.logging: Preserve original SDLOG_PROFILE bits OR16 OR1024; audited RAM logging and durable archive; no required dropout/gap

order: TH18 -> TV18 -> training selection commit -> VH9 -> VV9; PID first in each candidate/block
authority: Current RI06 user request only:54 finite attempts; first mandatory failure stops; no retries/push/formal

score.formula: mean over H/V x 2 seeds of (J / .01 + .10 * mean_axis_correction_TV_per_s)
score.J: arithmetic mean of three time-weighted axis RMSE, m/s
score.eligibility: four accepted complete runs, independent replay, paired development risk
